name: Mailtric
author: Mailtric

sections.description:
Mailtric is a 100% free WordPress email log and analytics plugin. It gives you Mail Metrics for WordPress – a complete email log and analytics solution for everything your site sends. It automatically records every email sent via wp_mail(), shows you what was delivered, opened, clicked, or bounced, and lets you resend important messages in a couple of clicks.

All features are included in the free plugin: full email logging, delivery analytics, one-click resend, light and dark mode UI, powerful filters, and more. There is no pro version, no feature locking, and no usage limits – just install and start tracking your WordPress emails.

The interface is designed to feel native in WordPress and includes both light and dark mode layouts, so your email logs look great and are easy to read whatever theme or preference you use in the admin.

Instead of guessing whether password resets, order confirmations, or contact form messages were delivered, you get a searchable, filterable email log and an at-a-glance dashboard of key email stats. This makes Mailtric ideal for:

  • Client sites where email reliability really matters.
  • WooCommerce and other e-commerce stores.
  • Membership, LMS, community, and booking sites.
  • Any WordPress site that can’t afford to lose important emails.

Mailtric focuses purely on logging, auditing and insights, so it works alongside your existing SMTP or email delivery service – all with the same full feature set in the free plugin.

Key Features

  • Full WordPress email logging
    Automatically log every email sent through wp_mail(). See subject, recipient, headers, and status in a clean email log.

  • Email delivery insights & metrics
    Quickly see which emails are being opened, clicked, or bounced so you can spot deliverability issues before they become a problem.

  • Resend emails in one click
    Resend failed or bounced emails directly from the log. Perfect for critical emails like order confirmations, account activations, and password resets.

  • Clear analytics dashboard
    Get an overview of how your WordPress email is performing over time with simple, visual stats and summary cards.

  • Smart filters & search
    Quickly find emails by subject, recipient, date range, or status so you can debug specific issues fast.

  • Light & dark mode UI
    Enjoy a modern interface that supports both light and dark mode, making your email logs comfortable to work with at any time of day.

  • Built to work with your stack
    Because Mailtric logs via wp_mail(), it works with most contact form plugins, WooCommerce and other e-commerce plugins, membership plugins, and SMTP/email services that integrate with WordPress.

  • Performance-friendly
    Logging is designed to be efficient and light so you can monitor your email without slowing down your site.

  • Simple UI for non-developers
    The admin screens are designed to be readable and intuitive, so clients and non-technical users can understand what’s happening with their email.

  • Multilingual interface (English, Spanish, French)
    Mailtric’s admin interface supports English, Spanish and French, making it easier to use on international and multilingual WordPress sites.

  • All features are free
    No paid add-ons, no pro upgrade, and no limits on which features you can use – everything shown in the screenshots is available in the free plugin.

Support

If you have questions, feature requests, or need help debugging an issue, please use the support forum on WordPress.org or the contact options linked from the Mailtric website.
sections.installation:
1. Install via WordPress (recommended)

    1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New.
    2. Search for “Mailtric”.
    3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

  2. Manual installation

    1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/mailtric.
    2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.

Once activated, Mailtric will begin logging emails sent via wp_mail() automatically. You’ll find the Mailtric pages in your WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
What emails does Mailtric log?

Mailtric logs emails sent via the WordPress wp_mail() function. This typically includes:

  • Core WordPress notification emails.
  • Contact form emails from most popular form plugins.
  • Transactional emails from WooCommerce and other e-commerce plugins that use wp_mail().
  • Membership, LMS, booking, and other plugin emails that rely on WordPress’ native mail system.

If a plugin uses wp_mail(), it will usually appear in the Mailtric logs.

Does Mailtric improve email deliverability by itself?

Mailtric doesn’t send emails – it monitors them. It gives you visibility into send status, opens, clicks, and bounces so that you can identify problems and then fix them by configuring a proper SMTP or email delivery service.

For best results, use Mailtric alongside a dedicated SMTP/email provider (such as SendGrid, Mailgun, SES, etc.) and use the logs and metrics to verify that configuration.

Can I resend emails?

Yes. You can resend selected emails directly from the Mailtric email log. This is particularly useful if your SMTP or email provider had a temporary issue and you want to re-send important messages.

Will this slow down my site?

Mailtric is designed to be efficient. It focuses on lightweight logging and uses optimised queries so it can run alongside your existing plugins without noticeably affecting performance.

Does Mailtric replace my SMTP plugin?

No. Mailtric is an email log and analytics plugin, not an SMTP plugin. It works with your existing SMTP or transactional email service and helps you see what’s actually happening with the emails that are being sent.

screenshots.caption: Mailtric dashboard in WordPress – overview of your WordPress email metrics, including total emails sent, delivered, opened, clicked, and bounced.
Full WordPress email log – searchable list of every outgoing email with subject, recipient, status, and send time.
Email detail view – see the full content, headers, meta data, and delivery information for a single logged email.
Resend email from the log – one-click resend action for failed or bounced emails directly from the Mailtric email log.
Filter email logs by status – quickly focus on sent, opened, clicked, bounced, or failed emails to troubleshoot deliverability.
Advanced search and filtering – search the email log by subject line, recipient address, or date range to find exactly what you need.
Email delivery analytics chart – visual graph showing email volume and performance over time for your WordPress site.
Opens and clicks breakdown – see how many emails are opened and clicked so you can measure engagement with transactional emails.
Bounce and failure insights – highlight view of bounced and failed emails to help you diagnose and fix email deliverability problems.
Core WordPress notification emails – example of WordPress system emails (like password resets and new user notifications) tracked inside Mailtric.
Contact form email logging – example log entries for contact form submissions sent via popular WordPress form plugins.
E-commerce / WooCommerce emails – transactional order emails from your store, logged and tracked inside the Mailtric email log.
Per-email status timeline – detailed view showing how an individual email progressed from sent to opened, clicked, or bounced.
Mailtric settings page – configure who can access logs, what data to store, and how long to retain your WordPress email history.
Log retention & privacy controls – options to control log retention periods and align your email logging with privacy policies.
Email content preview – inline preview of the email body so you can quickly confirm exactly what was sent to a recipient.
Sortable columns in the email log – sort by date, subject, recipient, or delivery status to analyse your WordPress emails efficiently.
Clean, modern light & dark mode UI – the Mailtric interface integrated into the WordPress admin, showcasing both light and dark mode layouts.
